children: Indian markets are facing pressure from elevated crude prices, US bond yields and weak FPI participation, according to Nuvama Institutional Equities’ Shiv Diwan. He expects valuations and steady earnings growth to provide some support, while highlighting industrial automation, railways, defence and precision engineering as areas with strong earnings visibility.

title: Indian markets stuck in a wait-and-watch phase as FPIs stay cautious: Shiv Diwan
